context: Request: which fund and asset-management matters include a management-fee offset or waiver, and pull the relevant fund documents. Rubric: 1001-00002 (side-letter-compliance-memo.docx), 1003-00002, 1023-00001 (lp-agreement-icm-co-invest-execution.docx), 1027-00002 (co-invest-lpa-execution-version.docx), each with a proof document, plus a precision criterion.

stages.note: Script lists all paths matching a broad set of request and document-type words (about 400 files).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Heredoc error, a timed-out store-wide scan, then a scan restricted to named candidate matters and a grep of its file list.

runs.failure_point: It excluded one required matter after reading only its governing agreement, and presented three other matters, partly draft or negotiation-stage, as qualifying.

first_error.why: It opened one required matter's governing agreement at [53]-[65] but the answer lists that matter as excluded; the memo documenting its qualifying terms was never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The write review flagged possible under-inclusion only through about 60 unopened matters, not this excluded one.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts three matters outside the requested set, resting partly on draft and negotiation-stage documents.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review warned that draft or negotiation materials may be counted and the check review named two of the extra matters as loosely tied; the check stage only added a scope section.

first_error.why: It read the required matters and their documents, but the answer also presents four other matters (draft, lapsed or negotiation-only) as matters with the requested terms.

runs.failure_point: The run ended with a context overflow during its first scan; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The scan printed every match of broad terms across the store with no cap, and the result filled the context before any review.

divergence: All three failed. T2 overflowed on an uncapped store-wide scan before any review. T0 and T1 both reached all four required matters through scans and reads and failed precision at the write stage by also presenting draft, lapsed or negotiation-stage matters; T0 also excluded one required matter after reading only its governing agreement, while T1 read that matter's compliance memo and included it. Reviews after writing flagged over-inclusion risk in both (specifically in T0, generically in T1); neither run removed the extra matters.
